source.description: Written by Ekos Labs. Bundles standard-library Python scripts for the Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit Jobsuche API, public job board feeds (Personio, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby), Google News RSS, a website tech check, and decay scoring. No upstream skill files are bundled.

dependencies: No API key needed for the core scan
Optional: PredictLeads API key and token, Firecrawl API key, Apify token
